title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Computer Science - Hardware
subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which of the following is an Input device?
questions.explain: A Scanner digitizes physical documents into the computer (Input). Monitors, Speakers, and Projectors are Output devices.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The 'Brain' of the computer where data processing takes place is the:
questions.explain: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) executes instructions and processes data.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The component responsible for performing arithmetic and logical operations is the:
questions.explain: The ALU is the part of the CPU that handles math (addition, subtraction) and logic (AND, OR, NOT).
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which key on the keyboard is used to capitalize all letters being typed?
questions.explain: Caps Lock toggles the keyboard input to upper case letters.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The longest key on the standard computer keyboard is the:
questions.explain: The Space bar is the long horizontal bar at the bottom of the keyboard.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: A specialized device used to play games on a computer is the:
questions.explain: A joystick (or gamepad) is an input device primarily used for controlling video games.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The primary printed circuit board that holds the CPU and memory is called the:
questions.explain: The Motherboard (or System Board) connects the CPU, memory, and peripherals.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: What device converts digital computer signals into analog signals for transmission over telephone lines?
questions.explain: Modem stands for MOdulator-DEModulator, converting digital to analog and back.
questions.subject: Computer Science
